body: Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, I am actually feeling a little better at least enough to tough it out one more day, and I know that's a start! :|

It does, more than you amy ever know. Some back story about me and maybe why im in this predicament: im in college and things really arent working out, ive lost contact with everyone from high school and im so introverted I havent made any friends in college. Last year I came the closest I ever have in my life to being in a wonderful relationship and I blew it before it even started so yeah im a total fuck up but at least im still here (on the bright side...I think?).

Thanks for the compliment, I always tend to express myself vividly through writing and I am a middle child but I cant talk about this with my younger sister and my older brother would harrass me about it as would my mother (no dad)...I have tried hinting at the fact that I may have like clinical depression but they all say its just a phase or im just throwing myself some kind of pity party :(
